top_signals.title: Oil Supply Risks Rise After Saudi Pipeline Attack
top_signals.summary: Saudi Arabia shut its East-West Pipeline as a precaution after multiple attacks, threatening a crucial route for moving crude to the Red Sea while bypassing disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz. Bloomberg Economics' Ziad Daoud says prolonged disruption could tighten global energy supplies further, adding pressure to oil and US diesel prices. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: HDFC Bank Submits Names of Two CEO Candidates to RBI
top_signals.summary: HDFC Bank Ltd. said it has submitted the names of two candidates to the Reserve Bank of India for the position of managing director and chief executive officer.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.summary: Off-the-cuff remarks from US president during a visit to Ireland anger pro-UK parties
